releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.8 (Pristine Text Inpainting & Intelligent ID Card Studio)
changelog:
✨ Pristine Document Text Inpainting & Intelligent ID Card Studio:
• 100% Elimination of Gray Inpainting Mud: Eradicated OpenCV Fast Marching smudging across text boxes; replaced with pure ambient document paper synthesis matching genuine lighting and paper tone.
• Guaranteed Complete Eradication of Original Text: 0 remnant pixels or underlying letter strokes remain when editing or replacing words.
• Vertical Paper Strip Sampling & Outlier Rejection: Samples authentic paper strictly from unpolluted strips above and below text lines, ignoring ink strokes and selection boundaries.
• Automatic ID Card Auto-Straighten & Dewarp: Automatically detects ID card boundaries from smartphone photos, removes background desks/bedsheets, auto-rotates to standard landscape, and snaps tightly to ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 proportions.
• Live ID Card Document Filters: Choose between Magic Color, Original, Sharp B&W, and Grayscale with instant real-time thumbnail preview.
• Direct 1-Tap A4 PDF Export: Generate official print-ready 2-sided A4 KYC PDFs with cutting guide and standard 1:1 scale with a single tap.
• Rotate 90° Controls: Instant orientation adjustment for upside-down or portrait card captures.
